scope: Proposition 6.8 (A uniform relative NQC bound) of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let f0 : U → Z be an already projective surjective morphism with connected fibres between smooth compact Kähler manifolds, and suppose that f∗ 0 : H0 (Z, Ω2 Z) −→ H0 (U, Ω2 U ) is an isomorphism. Let α0 be a nef class with an expression α0 = k X j=1 rjηj,0, rj > 0, ηj,0 ∈ H2 (U, Q), where ηj,0 has nonnegative degree on every curve vertical over Z. Let D0 = KU + ∆U + MU be a generalized klt adjoint. Consider its projective relative program for D0 + aα0, under the projective local ordinary reduction described in the proof of Proposition 6.21. If α0 = 0, triviality is immediate. Otherwise there are positive integers mj, chosen once on U, and a number δ = min j rj mj > 0 such that, for aδ > 2 dim U, the entire relative program is α0-trivial. The same number a works at every step.
